'''Hesten''' were [[Primate/Legends|primates]]<ref name="Trivia" /> with large ears, a long tail, four arms and two legs and were seen on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balnab/Legends|Balnab]].<ref name="ND" /> Very similar to the [[Momong/Legends|momongs]] on [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]],<ref name="Trivia" /> they were hunted by the [[Balnab (group)/Legends|Balnab]].<ref name="ND" /> In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]<ref>{{TCWdates|406}}</ref> [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] found themselves in a [[Hunting/Legends|hunt]] of the creatures after being stranded on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="ND" />

That [[20 BBY/Legends|same year]]<ref>{{TCWdates|411}}</ref> some hestens were pets of the [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Darts D'Nar/Legends|Darts D'Nar]].<ref name="Kidnapped">{{TCW|Kidnapped}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Hesten first appeared in the episode "[[Nomad Droids]]," the sixth episode of [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]] of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' television series]].<ref name="ND" /> Though going unnamed in the episode, they were identified as hesten in the episode guide trivia gallery.<ref name="Trivia">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep406|text="Nomad Droids" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref>
